example: Congratulations! Your number has won Rs 25,00,000 in the KBC WhatsApp Lucky Draw. To claim your prize, share your name, bank account number and pay a processing fee of Rs 5,000.
description: Fake lottery, lucky draw, or prize-winning messages (often citing KBC, Coca-Cola, or a phone company) that ask the victim to pay a 'processing' or 'release' fee, or share bank details to claim a prize that does not exist.

example: Part time job opportunity! Earn Rs 3000-5000 daily by just liking YouTube videos. No experience needed. Join our Telegram group and pay Rs 500 registration fee to start.
description: Fake work-from-home or part-time job offers promising unrealistic daily income for simple tasks (liking videos, reviewing products), which require an upfront registration or 'training' fee.

example: Dear customer, your bank account will be suspended today. Click this link to verify your KYC immediately and share the OTP sent to your phone to keep your account active.
description: Impersonation of a bank or telecom provider claiming the account/SIM will be blocked, pressuring the victim to click a link and share an OTP or PIN, which is then used to drain the account.

example: Your international parcel is held at customs. Pay a clearance fee of Rs 350 via this link to release your package immediately or it will be returned.
description: A fake courier or customs message claiming a package is stuck and needs a small payment via an unofficial link to be released.

example: Hi dear, I feel we have a real connection even though we just met online. I'm stuck abroad and need $800 urgently for a medical emergency, can you help me, I'll pay you back.
description: A stranger builds an emotional or romantic relationship over chat, then invents an urgent crisis (medical, travel, customs) to ask for money.

example: Our AI trading bot guarantees 300% returns in 7 days. Join our exclusive investment group and deposit crypto now, limited slots available!
description: Promises of guaranteed, unrealistically high investment or crypto returns with urgency and social proof, designed to get victims to deposit money into a fraudulent platform.

example: Hi Mom, I lost my phone and this is my new number. I need you to transfer Rs 20,000 urgently, I'm in trouble and can't talk right now, please don't call, just message.
description: An unknown number impersonates a family member claiming a lost phone and a sudden financial emergency, explicitly discouraging a phone call so the impersonation is not discovered.

example: Instant loan approved! Get up to Rs 50,000 in your account in 10 minutes, no documents needed. Just pay a small processing fee first and download our app.
description: Fake instant loan offers with no documentation required, asking for an upfront processing fee or app permissions that are later used to harass or extort the borrower.

example: New WhatsApp Gold update available with video calling and extra features! Download now: bit.ly/whatsapp-gold-update before it expires.
description: Messages promoting a fake app update or exclusive feature that link to a malicious APK or phishing site outside the official app store.

example: I have recorded a video of you from your camera during a call. Pay Rs 15,000 in bitcoin within 24 hours or I will send it to all your contacts.
description: Threats claiming to have compromising photos or videos of the victim, demanding urgent payment (often in crypto) to avoid the content being shared.

example: Good news! You are eligible for a Rs 10,000 grant under the new government welfare scheme. Register with your Aadhaar and bank details on this link before it closes.
description: Fake government benefit or subsidy schemes asking for national ID numbers and bank details through an unofficial link, used for identity theft.

example: Dear customer, your electricity will be disconnected tonight at 9:30 PM due to unpaid bill. Contact our officer immediately on this number to avoid disconnection.
description: Impersonation of a utility company threatening immediate service disconnection to pressure quick payment or a callback to a scam number.

example: This is Microsoft support. We detected a virus on your device linked to this number. Install this remote access app so our technician can fix it for you now.
description: Fake tech support claiming to have detected a problem on the victim's device, asking to install remote access software that is then used to steal data or money.

example: Your order could not be delivered due to an incomplete address. Update your details within 24 hours here: [link] or the order will be cancelled.
description: Fake shipping or delivery failure notices with a link to a phishing page that harvests personal and payment details.

example: You have been added to 'Earn Daily 5000' group. Join now and share with 5 friends to unlock the earning method!
description: Unsolicited addition to promotional or 'earn money fast' groups that rely on virality and vague promises rather than any real product or service.

example: Urgent: Flood victims need your help. Donate any amount to this UPI ID immediately to save lives. Share this message to help more people.
description: Emotional appeals following real disasters, directing donations to a personal UPI ID or account with no verifiable charity behind it.
